fields.def: Drop it from the FileSystem onto the node it goes under.
fields.note: 2 October 2026, chapter 2: FUNCTIONAL_TEXT 2a said the walker of 2.5 is the second supplied scene dropped, which makes that drop an admin, defined at 1.6. 1.6 defines it for counter_panel.tscn; 2.5 calls it for walker.tscn: 'Add `walker.tscn` to the top node.' Its call is 'add {file} to', so it never collides with put a script on a node ('put {file} on'). Its step phrase 'drop' counts only beside a .tscn, so a script dropped (`bell.gd`) stays put a script on a node; no 'drop {file} onto' synonym, since {file} takes a .gd too and the longer match would win. The editor step is NOT verified in a live editor.
